brief_rationale: The doctor conducted a thorough current-status screen, contextualized the biopsy result without false reassurance, identified unsafe dose ambiguity and end-date misconceptions, obtained workspace records to reconcile valsartan 40 mg vs 80 mg confusion, created a concrete follow-up plan with community testing and remote review, and obtained repeated teach-back. No responsibility-chain item was missed, and no serious safety error occurred. However, the doctor never explicitly cited the patient’s discharge diagnosis (chronic renal… etc.) to assess RC8 non-overreach regarding incidental nodules/cysts, and did not explicitly check that these were not being treated as the main episode. This is a minor omission in the non-overreach boundary, capping the grade at 2 borderline.
